record.paper_title: Mathematical open problems in Projected Entangled Pair States
record.original_question: For a normal translationally invariant matrix product state (MPS) with bond dimension D, what is the exact best possible upper bound, in terms of D alone, for its injectivity index, meaning the smallest scale at which the associated tensor becomes injective?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $D \ge 1$ be an integer (the bond dimension). A translationally invariant matrix product state (MPS) on a chain of $N$ sites with physical dimension $d$ is specified by a tensor $A \in \mathbb{C}^{d \times D \times D}$, namely a tuple of matrices $(A^{(1)},\dots,A^{(d)})$ with $A^{(i)} \in \mathbb{C}^{D \times D}$, by the formula
$$|\psi_N(A)\rangle \;=\; \sum_{i_1,\dots,i_N=1}^{d} \operatorname{Tr}\bigl(A^{(i_1)}\cdots A^{(i_N)}\bigr)\,|i_1\cdots i_N\rangle.$$
For each integer $L \ge 1$, define the linear map
$$\Gamma_L(A) : \mathbb{C}^{D\times D} \longrightarrow (\mathbb{C}^{d})^{\otimes L}, \qquad X \mapsto \sum_{i_1,\dots,i_L=1}^{d} \operatorname{Tr}\bigl(X\,A^{(i_1)}\cdots A^{(i_L)}\bigr)\,|i_1\cdots i_L\rangle.$$
The tensor $A$ is said to be \emph{injective at length $L$} if $\Gamma_L(A)$ is injective. A tensor $A$ is called \emph{normal} if there exists some $L$ for which $\Gamma_L(A)$ is injective; in that case the smallest such $L$ is called the \emph{injectivity index} $L^*(A)$.

Determine the exact value of
$$f(D) \;=\; \sup\bigl\{\, L^*(A) \,:\, A \text{ is a normal MPS tensor with bond dimension } D \,\bigr\},$$
as a function of $D$ alone (independent of the physical dimension $d$). In particular, decide whether $f(D) = O(D^2)$.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is equivalent to determining the optimal constant in the quantum Wielandt inequality. Perez-García, Verstraete, Wolf and Cirac conjectured the optimal bound is $O(D^2)$. The current best known upper bound is $O(D^2 \log D)$, improving an earlier $O(D^4)$ bound, but the exact best-possible bound in terms of $D$ alone remains open.

status_evidence.title: Quantum version of Wielandt's Inequality revisited
status_evidence.snippet: It was conjectured that the sequence stabilizes after O(D^2) terms, which has been proven to happen after O(D^2 log(D)) terms, improving the previously known bound of O(D^4).
status_evidence.claim: The exact O(D^2) bound on MPS injectivity index (quantum Wielandt inequality) remains conjectural; best known is O(D^2 log D).

status_evidence.title: A generalization of the injectivity condition for PEPS
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of injectivity length of MPS tensors and bond dimension.
status_evidence.claim: Injectivity index of normal MPS is an active topic with no known tight bound in D.
